Summary
: The English translation of the Brihad Bhagavatamrita including the commentary called Dig-darshini-tika. It contains the essence of the Shrimad Bhagavatam (Bhagavata Purana) while the subject matters pertains to devotional service. The setting of this book is based on a conversation between Shri Jaimini and Shri Janamejaya and Shri Parikshit and Shri Uttara.
This version of the Brihad-Bhagavatamrita (Brhad-bhagavatamrta) contains the English translation, the original Sanskrit text and a commentary. The full title is: Śrī Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta (श्री बृहद्-भागवतामृत) by Sanātana Gosvāmī.
